findings.text: the gate log the manifest names as both test_logs and negative_control_log is a killed run's partial output: its header line 3 names rev 722bd843c0839fbbbaddcf6530181abcb9eebe26 and its last line is the positive-control line stamped 20:59:29, with no EXIT line anywhere in the file, because the worker's final re-run of the gate was terminated -- the run's own stream records that command's tool result as 'Exit code 144' with is_error true, and the supervisor stopped the worker at 21:01:05Z. So the manifest's 'gate: exit 0' and the HTML's 'last line EXIT=0' cite a receipt that does not exist, and a promotion reading the gate's exit status from that log's last line reads nothing. The underlying measurement is corroborated (a complete EXIT=0 run at a7f985d6d produced rows identical to the committed JSON), so the repair is to re-run the runner at the head revision so its log ends in a real EXIT=0, or to point test_logs at a log that does.

the terminated gate run left its scratch tree behind (2.6 GB dump plus instance/), because the runner's finally block never ran, so the done_when's 'the scratch instance is stopped and removed' holds for the run whose JSON was kept but not for the last one executed; no neo4j process survives it, and this review is fenced out of deleting it.

the reproduce section states the log is at revision a9ff6a562 with last line EXIT=0, which was true when the HTML was written and is false of the file now on disk (rev 722bd843c, no EXIT line), so a reader following the pointer is misled about which revision the cited receipt proves; repair it with the log.

_doc_link_targets re-implements, with a narrower and image-unguarded pattern, the link parsing the repository already owns at imas_codex/standard_names/doc_links.py:110 (find_name_links) and :22 (_NAME_LINK_RE), which docs_gates.py:21, graph_ops.py:38 and harmonize.py:33 already use; the same owner also provides find_self_links for the self-referential link defect the report classes as 'no check reads', which is true only in the sense that no gate calls it.
